name: vq2_dark_red
description: APPEARANCE-MATCHED to real VQ2: a DARK industrial hangar, gates that GLOW orange-red and carry printed AI-GP / checkerboard / DCL / ANDURIL / VQ-01 signage. Replaces the bright-HDRI bare-red look whose domain gap was MEASURED, not guessed. (1) An M+1 keypoint model trained on the old synthetic data and validated on REAL hand-labelled frames PEAKED AT EPOCH 10 (pose mAP50 0.503) then decayed to 0.282 by epoch 100, centre error 20.5 -> 35.6 px, coverage 98% -> 84% -- the extra epochs learned synthetic APPEARANCE, not gates. (2) A segmentation model scored 28.5 px centre error on synthetic val against 80 px on real frames. (3) Population statistics, 400 real frames vs 400 old-synthetic: background MEDIAN GRAY 36.7 real vs 104.4 synthetic (~3x too bright), gate hue 17.8 vs 14.5 deg, gate saturation 205 vs 183, gate value 206 vs 169. After this preset, measured over 24 frames: background median 36.3, hue 20.8, sat 191, value 181 -- real is bracketed on every axis by this arm together with vq2_dark_red_partial. NOTES ON THE KNOBS. The appearance numbers were calibrated in 5 passes and they INTERACT: under the Standard (clipping) view transform the red channel pins at 1.0 while green keeps climbing, so gate_emission_range drives hue, saturation AND value together -- retune it and re-measure all three. augment.brightness_p is cut from vq1_partial's 0.5 because RandomBrightnessContrast is a +/-0.25 ADDITIVE shift, i.e. up to 64 gray levels on a population whose target median is 36, which would undo the point of the preset; brightness variety comes from appearance.exposure_range instead, where it is a physical pre-tonemap scale. photometric_p stays high because that is the LOAD-BEARING sensor aug (good-fix 80% -> 22% without it). General-purpose envelope (vq1_faithful geometry); blend with vq2_dark_red_partial the way vq1_faithful blends with vq1_partial.
